projectStatus.focus: Use Stark Founder V0 as the immutable control baseline, expand the memory benchmark, and test persistent recurrent state across chunks without unacceptable regression in held-out language performance.

logs.title: M7 evaluation passed; Stark Founder V0 frozen
logs.summary: M7 verified the validation-selected step-18,000 checkpoint, measured untouched test loss 3.8932 / perplexity 49.07, recorded reasoning 40%, knowledge 25%, exact context recall 25%, and froze the model as the canonical baseline.

logs.title: PRETRAIN-001 completed
logs.summary: Founder V0 completed 19,456 optimizer steps and 250,009,600 processed tokens. Validation selected step 18,000 at 226,177,792 tokens as canonical.

logs.title: M6 training engine acceptance closed
logs.summary: CUDA/BF16 smoke, intentional memorization, bitwise crash/resume equivalence and real-data generalization all passed. Training state can resume without changing the trajectory.

logs.title: Founder architecture assembled
logs.summary: M1–M5 established 256d embeddings, RoPE, 4-head causal attention, gated MLP blocks and the 8-layer 11.54M-parameter Founder language model.

logs.title: Stark Tokenizer V0 frozen
logs.summary: The 12,288-token BPE tokenizer was selected, contract-tested and frozen to a content-addressed corpus and immutable model-facing identity.

logs.title: Native digital-life architecture snapshot published
logs.summary: The earlier public architecture established local-first runtime, native advisory substrate and staged authority promotion. The September Founder work now adds a measured Stark-native neural substrate to that broader design.

milestones.title: Tokenizer V0
milestones.summary: 12,288 model-facing token IDs; BPE, digit isolation, round-trip and native parity contracts frozen.

milestones.title: Token Embedding
milestones.summary: 256-dimensional tied embeddings with PAD invariants and deterministic inspection.

milestones.title: Position + Context Contracts
milestones.summary: RoPE and activation-plan contracts established for bounded physical context and future routed memory.

milestones.title: Local Causal Attention
milestones.summary: 4 heads × 64 dimensions, causal integrity, incremental equivalence and bounded KV cache.

milestones.title: Complete Transformer Block
milestones.summary: Pre-norm RMSNorm plus SiLU-gated MLP assembled and verified.

milestones.title: Founder Language Model
milestones.summary: Eight blocks assembled into an 11,538,688-parameter autoregressive LM with tied output projection.

milestones.title: Training Infrastructure
milestones.summary: CUDA/BF16 training, curriculum, checkpoints, exact resume, overfit and generalization gates.

milestones.title: PRETRAIN-001
milestones.summary: 250,009,600 tokens processed; step 18,000 selected by validation as canonical.

milestones.title: Evaluation & Baseline Freeze
milestones.summary: Held-out test, generation, reasoning, knowledge, context, robustness, performance and t0/best/final comparisons recorded.

milestones.title: Working Memory & Recurrent Context
milestones.summary: Expand exact recall benchmarks, add persistent recurrent state, test beyond 1024 logical context, and preserve Founder language capability.

milestones.title: Cells, Routing & Long-term Memory
milestones.summary: Specialized cells, heterogeneous mechanisms, retrieval, episodic/semantic memory and governed sleep consolidation follow only after measurable memory gains.

notes.title: Context length is not memory
notes.body: Founder has a 1024-token physical attention window but remained at 25% chance exact recall across all tested distances. Future context mechanisms must be judged by recall, not advertised window size.

notes.title: The test set is not a selector
notes.body: The final checkpoint scored 0.001 lower test loss than the validation-selected best, but the canonical model remains step 18,000. Switching after observing test results would leak the test set into model selection.

notes.title: Founder is a substrate
notes.body: Weak stable knowledge and arithmetic are not hidden. The project treats the model as a language substrate that later memory, cells, retrieval and reasoning mechanisms must augment.

notes.title: One mechanism at a time
notes.body: RMT, Mamba-style state, sparse attention, retrieval, Infini-style memory and cells may eventually layer together. M8 starts with a minimal recurrent-memory experiment so causal improvements remain measurable.
